 Explained - Why shares of BSE, Angel One, Groww fell from their day's high on Tuesday
 BSE ANGELONE GROWW Shares of the Bombay Stock Exchange (BSE) Ltd., Billionbrains Garage Ventures Ltd., (Groww), Angel One Ltd., gave up most or all of their gains on Tuesday, November 17, after a Reuters report cited sources, and stated that market regulator Securities and Exchange Board of India could consider restrictions on fresh leveraged stock purchases. 
 Nearly two-thirds of the MTF book comprises of small and midcap stocks. The Reuters report stated that fresh MTF purchases could be blocked once margin-funding holding reaches 5% to 10% of a stock's free float. 
 Over 220 stocks on the MTF book currently have exposure exceeding 5% of their free float, and at least 36 of them exceed the 10% threshold. 
 MTF Book & Free Float 
 If 10% threshold If 5% threshold 
 Stocks impacted 36 226 
 MTF exposure (₹ Crore) 6,253 35,023 
 Exposure above threshold (₹ Crore) 1,371 12,693 
 Daily trading turnover basis 30-day average (₹ Crore) 1,894 15,276 
 The concern, as per the Reuters report, is that market corrections could trigger margin calls and amplify the selling pressure. 
 According to analysts, this move could act as a potential headwind for the MTF book growth for brokers and impact trading activity as well. 
 Groww, Angel One, and other brokers have MTF books of their own as well. 
 These stocks are high liquidity risk or those having exposure above the proposed 5% threshold of the daily turnover. 
 Stock Excess MTF exposure (₹ Crore) Multiples of daily turnover 
 ABFRL 239 11.3x 
 Nazara Tech 544 7.7x 
 Sammaan Capital 343 4.2x 
 Anant Raj 339 3.3x 
 Tourism Finance 553 2.2x 
 NSE MTF Book 
 Shares of BSE had made an intraday high of ₹4,003 but the stock has now come off the highs of the day to trade 0.6% lower at ₹3,865.6. 
 Shares of Angel one reversed gains of as much as 9% intraday, and are now trading just 1.5% higher at ₹353.05. 
 Shares of Billionbrains Garage Ventures (Groww), also in the news for the block deal which took place earlier in the day, are off their intraday post-listing high of ₹233.4, and are now trading 0.7% higher at ₹226.6.
